tool_args.rationale: The failed smooth saturating-plus-linear-gradient model is contradicted by fresh confirmation. The paid data now span sink gradient, and the verified supply-bridge mechanism maps to the inland-hub siphon form. Fit its three parameters numerically, including the open square-root branch coefficient, rather than buying a trajectory batch unsupported by the current evidence.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed variation is in sink gradient, and the bridge/source siphon family has an explicit gradient response; an ODE trajectory batch is not the most direct remaining test.
It is explicitly nuisance-only and would not resolve the mechanism.

considered_alternatives.option: saturating response plus additive linear gradient correction
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Fresh confirmation refuted this prior model; the two varying-gradient observations instead support multiplicative sink inhibition with an open square-root branch term.
It cannot account for the large output changes between the two gradient-varied observations.
